Whether a talaq-bayen occurred between us. 2. If yes, was our Nikah that we performed alone is valid without any witness. 3. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 32707 Country: India Title: KULA Question: Is it possible when the women has told kula and same time the man also agreed and told thalaq in this case wheter she can apply for maintenance according to the shariyad law? (she leaved with the husband's family for 15 days only and she also reback the jehaz articles at the period through the police) Answer ID: 32707 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1148/1148/M=1432) In the question mentioned above, the woman can demand for maintenance of her iddah period provided no defiance is found from her side. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
